metadata.description: YOUR AIOS 2.0: start small; install the next pack when you need it.

plugins.name: skool-navaigate-install
plugins.description: First-generation community skills: fixes-only support until 26 April 2027.

plugins.name: aios
plugins.description: Start here. Check your harnesses and choose your next module.

plugins.name: aios-rules
plugins.description: Module 2: your folder map, one short AGENTS.md, path-scoped rules, a budget check and a monthly audit.

plugins.name: aios-harnesses
plugins.description: Module 3: set up Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Grok Bot on one folder, and check they match.

plugins.name: aios-bb
plugins.description: Module 4: bb as the cockpit - project setup, the board and the daily loop.

plugins.name: aios-brain
plugins.description: Your own local memory, with optional sync to your own Turso database.

plugins.name: aios-skills
plugins.description: Module 6. Write, measure, hide and test skills, and scaffold new ones with their evals.

plugins.name: aios-agents
plugins.description: Module 7. When a sub-agent earns its place, a brief template and checker, and a small read-only crew.

plugins.name: aios-verify
plugins.description: Module 8. Checks, a Stop gate, REVIEW.md and a PR template, and hooks for no secrets, no destructive git and confirm before production.

plugins.name: aios-methods
plugins.description: Module 9. Loops with a check, worktrees for parallel work, interview before you build.

plugins.name: aios-models
plugins.description: Module 10. Which model does what, medium effort first, the advisor, and two logins.

plugins.name: aios-ship
plugins.description: Module 11. Package a skill as a pack with tests, evals and installers, then validate it.

plugins.name: shelf-content-pipeline
plugins.description: The shelf: capture content ideas, develop each against your strategy, and schedule them with a make-by date, in one local file you can open.

plugins.name: shelf-daily-brief
plugins.description: The shelf: a morning brief you will actually read: your numbers, yesterday's meetings and Slack, and what needs attention, written by one model call and saved to your project.

plugins.name: shelf-decks
plugins.description: The shelf: a deck in your own brand. HTML first, every slide reviewed, then an editable PowerPoint and a PDF.

plugins.name: shelf-deep-research
plugins.description: The shelf: run a multi-source research pass: scope the question, recon the sources, read them in parallel, run a critic pass, then write up with confidence labels.

plugins.name: shelf-design-brain
plugins.description: The shelf: query 1,119 sourced design fundamentals and get design critiques that cite the entry number and the named source.

plugins.name: shelf-diagrams
plugins.description: The shelf: describe a system in plain English and get a clean architecture, pipeline or funnel diagram drawn with D2 and checked by eye.

plugins.name: shelf-exec-brief
plugins.description: The shelf: build a cream-paper A4 decision brief as one HTML file, with your own figures, ready to print to PDF.

plugins.name: shelf-hormozi
plugins.description: The shelf: run the Hormozi offer engine on your own offer, grounded in the books you own, citing book, chapter and page and refusing to invent.

plugins.name: shelf-invoices
plugins.description: The shelf: the invoice NavAIgate sends, in our house design, from your own company settings. Numbered, checked as a PDF, filed.

plugins.name: shelf-podcasts
plugins.description: The shelf: find the right podcast episodes, rank a shortlist, and pull the full transcripts of the ones you pick.

plugins.name: shelf-thumbnails
plugins.description: The shelf: make four on-brand video thumbnail concepts from your own photos, then add the headline as a real text layer so it is spelled correctly.

plugins.name: shelf-transcripts
plugins.description: The shelf: pull the full words of a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or X video, then extract decisions, objections and quotes from them.

plugins.name: shelf-video
plugins.description: The shelf: edit a talking-head recording locally. Whisper transcript, filler words out, captions in, MP4 out.

plugins.name: shelf-web-scrape
plugins.description: The shelf: search the web by meaning and read any page, including JavaScript-heavy ones, with your own Exa and Firecrawl keys.

plugins.name: shelf-writing-style
plugins.description: The shelf: scrub AI slop out of a draft before you ship it: banned words, em dashes, wind-ups and model tells, keeping your names, numbers and claims.

plugins.name: aios-complete
plugins.description: The whole framework in one install: aios, the brain and every core pack for modules 2 to 11.
